article.text: Why are so many people ending up in care homes despite "world class" medicine?

items: The reason is simple.
Pain medications, like those prescribed by doctors, almost always mask symptoms without addressing the root cause.
They are: "NSAIDs" and "Corticosteroids".
Now, in case you think these are helping... they're actually making things worse. NSAIDs include common drugs like: Ibuprofen, Naproxen, and Celebrex.
And Corticosteroids include:
Prednisone...
Cortisone shots...
And...
Methylprednisolone.
Now, all of these have been heavily marketed as safe ways to manage pain. In fact, most people truly believe these are helping their bodies heal.
But if that's true...
Then why are so many seniors struggling with worsening mobility and independence?
I mean, we live in the most medically advanced time in history.
We have more drugs and treatments than ever before.
Yet the number of people in nursing homes is higher than ever.
